questions.q: A customer has Zebra TC52 handhelds. What is the IOR replacement?
questions.e: The mid-tier TC52/57/58 family maps to the Urovo DT50.

questions.q: Why does the Bixolon/Toshiba printer migration carry low workflow risk for the customer?
o: They emulate ZPL II, so they drop into a Zebra estate without rewriting label formats
They use the same Zebra DNA software
They are made by Zebra under licence
questions.e: ZPL II emulation means existing label formats, BarTender templates and middleware keep working — a drop-in replacement with no format rewrites.

questions.q: A customer runs Zebra ZQ610 mobile printers. What is the key thing to check before quoting the Urovo replacement?
o: That ZPL support is confirmed — it needs SDK work, so pre-qualify
That the printer prints in colour
Nothing — it is a straight drop-in
questions.e: The ZQ610 maps to the Urovo SP319/SP409, but ZPL needs SDK work. Always pre-qualify the ZPL requirement before committing to a quote.
